messages:
maria.g: Heads-up: I'm about to rename the secret namespace var in terraform (secret_namespace -> secret_path) for prod overlays. Opening PR in a few mins. Can folks do a quick check on kustomize / overlay fallout?

kevin_h: pinged. which PR? link please + any tf plan output we should look at. :eyes:

maria.g: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4827 — main change is in modules/secrets/variables.tf and overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml to switch to absolute path style.

maria.g: main concern is that the prod overlay currently uses a secret name mapping in kustomize patch that expects `namespace: redwood-secrets` and terraform will start writing to `secret-paths/prod/...` instead of previous `prod/redwood-secrets`.

olivia: quick thought: if kustomize still references `metadata.name: redwood-secrets` but applications expect secrets at a different path in secret manager, we need a migration or alias. Is this purely AWS SecretsManager path rename?

maria.g: yes, AWS SecretsManager path rename. Terraform will change ssm/secrets module to write new path key. We planned to consolidate paths but want minimal risk for prod.

raj: can we add a fallback transformer in overlays/prod kustomization that keeps the old secret name until we flip? e.g., add a patch that sets annotations with both paths so runtime fetcher can fallback.

kevin_h: short checklist I ran locally:
```
# run from repo root
git fetch origin && git checkout pr/4827
terraform init -backend-config=env/prod.tfbackend
terraform plan -var="environment=prod" -var-file=env/prod.tfvars
kustomize build overlays/prod | kubectl apply --server-dry-run=client -f -
```
Works but the plan shows resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" will be recreated because path attribute changed. That will rotate ARNs.

olivia: if recreation is unavoidable, do we have a migration script to copy secret values to the new path before apply? We should not delete the old secret before traffic flips.

maria.g: I added a one-off migration job in the PR: scripts/migrations/copy-secrets-prod.sh — it uses aws cli to copy by name, and leaves old secrets intact. I'll push it to the branch.

raj: please include a tfstate lock note and run terraform apply with -target for the secrets module during the maintenance window. Also add a console runbook line to update Redwood Console secret path mapping (ops playbook).

maria.g: noted. Adding runbook steps in PR description now.

ci-bot: CI: overlay-promote-staging passed for branch pr/4827 — https://ci.internal/teams/infra/4827/builds/221

deploy-bot: PROMOTE JOB: staging->prod gating checks: canary deploy job queued. ETA ~15m.

kevin_h: quick ask to reviewers: check overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml patch I added. It has a transformer to add annotation `x-secret-path: secret-paths/prod/` and leaves metadata.name intact. If we want to be extra safe we can keep the old secret resource and create new alias secret resource with new path.

olivia: that sounds safe. also add a comment in the kustomization pointing to the migration script and the tf PR so future folks see the link.

maria.g: done. PR updated with migration script, runbook, and comment in kustomization. I'm going to run the copy script in a dry-run against staging first.

kevin_h: lgtm. will do a quick src review in ~10m. :thumbsup:

raj: FYI ops: I'll reserve the maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC tomorrow and put a calendar invite.

maria.g: thanks — merging after kevin review and staging copy run. will post status here once canary completes.

kevin_h: review complete, left one nit around variable name in variables.tf. nothing blocking.

maria.g: merging now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: CANARY: prod canary started for pr/4827 — 5% traffic. monitor: https://console.internal/monitoring/canaries/4827

olivia: watching logs. no errors so far.

maria.g: canary green for 20m, promoting to 100% in 5.

deploy-bot: PROMOTION: prod promotion succeeded for pr/4827. :white_check_mark:

maria.g: migration completed, old secrets retained for 30 days; updating runbook expiration. thanks everyone!
